'''Jami''' is a telecommunications platform for [[peer-to-peer]] and [[distributed_computing|distributed]] [[videotelephony]], videoconferencing, and [[voice_over_IP|voice calls]]. Jami is [[free and open-source software]] released under the [[GNU General Public License|GNU GPL-3.0-or-later]].<ref name="Hanson-2025" /> 

== History ==
In December 2004, Savoir-faire Linux launched the SFLPhone project.

In November 2009, ''[[CIO magazine]]'' listed SFLphone among the top five [[open source|open-source]] [[Voice over IP|VoIP]] [[Softphone|softphones]] to watch.<ref>{{Cite web|title = 5 open source VoIP softphones to watch|url = http://www.cio.com.au/article/327163/5_open_source_voip_softphones_watch/|website = CIO|access-date = January 3, 2012|archive-date = May 1, 2017|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20170501221610/http://www.cio.com.au/article/327163/5_open_source_voip_softphones_watch|url-status = dead}}</ref>

In May 2015, SFLphone was renamed to Ring.<ref>{{cite web|title=Savoir-faire Linux blog|date=May 5, 2015 |url=https://blog.savoirfairelinux.com/en-ca/2015/ring-ultimate-privacy-and-control-for-your-voice-video-and-chat-communications/|publisher=Savoir-faire Linux|accessdate=June 8, 2025}}</ref> 

In December 2018, Ring was renamed to Jami to avoid confusion with commercial products also using the English term ''Ring''.<ref name="Streets-2025">{{Cite web |last=Streets |first=Madeleine |date=2025-03-19 |title=9 Skype alternatives for video conferencing |url=https://www.techtarget.com/whatis/feature/Skype-alternatives-for-video-conferencing |url-status=live |archive-url=https://archive.today/20250712011841/https://www.techtarget.com/whatis/feature/Skype-alternatives-for-video-conferencing |archive-date=2025-07-12 |access-date=2025-07-12 |website=[[Informa TechTarget]] |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://ring.cx/en/news |title=Ring news |date=December 18, 2018 |website=Ring |language=en |access-date=December 1, 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181226012459/https://ring.cx/en/news|archive-date=December 26, 2018|url-status=dead}}</ref>

In 2025, ''[[TechRadar]]'' listed it as one alternative to [[Skype]] following its discontinuation.<ref name="Hanson-2025">{{Cite web |last1=Hanson |first1=Matt |last2=Turner |first2=Brian |last3=Ionescu |first3=Stefan |date=2025-05-07 |title=Best alternative to Skype of 2025 - what to replace it with following official Microsoft closure |url=https://www.techradar.com/best/best-alternatives-to-skype |url-status=live |archive-url=https://archive.today/20250708161800/https://www.techradar.com/best/best-alternatives-to-skype |archive-date=2025-07-08 |access-date=2025-07-08 |website=[[TechRadar]] |language=en}}</ref>

== Features ==
Available features depend on both the Jami client and the platform used.<ref name="Das-2023" />

* Operates on a [[peer-to-peer]] basis without a central server (apart from the centralised name server). Jami can be used on local networks without an [[Internet]] connection.<ref name="Streets-2025" />
* [[End-to-end encryption]] used for [[Online chat|chat]], [[Videotelephony|video]], and [[Voice over IP|voice]].<ref name="Das-2023">{{Cite web |last=Das |first=Ankush |date=2023-12-09 |title=Jami: A Versatile Open-Source Distributed Communication App |url=https://itsfoss.com/jami/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://archive.today/20250708164841/https://itsfoss.com/jami/ |archive-date=2025-07-08 |access-date=2025-07-08 |website=It's FOSS |language=en}}</ref>
* [[Session Initiation Protocol|SIP]]-compatible with OpenDHT support.<ref name="Sanders-2015" /><ref name="Das-2023" />
* Instant messaging.<ref name="Das-2023" />
* Call recording.<ref name="Sanders-2015">{{Cite web|title = Privacy-focused Skype alternative Ring shows promise – TechRepublic|url = http://www.techrepublic.com/article/privacy-focused-skype-alternative-ring-shows-promise/|work = TechRepublic|date= 18 May 2015|access-date = 8 July 2025|first = James|last = Sanders|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20230321025411/http://www.techrepublic.com/article/privacy-focused-skype-alternative-ring-shows-promise/|archivedate=21 March 2023}}</ref><ref name="Streets-2025"/>
* Audio and video calls with multi-party audio<ref name="Sanders-2015" /> and video conferencing.<ref name="Huber-2014">{{Cite web|title = Software-Telefon SFLphone KDE 1.3.0 veröffentlicht » Linux-Magazin|url = http://www.linux-magazin.de/NEWS/Software-Telefon-SFLphone-KDE-1.3.0-veroeffentlicht|website = Linux-Magazin|access-date = February 19, 2016|first = Mathias|last = Huber| date=January 17, 2014 }}</ref><ref name="Das-2023" />

Usernames are stored on a private [[Ethereum]] blockchain administered centrally by Jami.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://docs.jami.net/en_US/user/faq.html#how-does-the-username-registration-service-work|title=FAQ — Jami documentation|website=Docs.jami.net|access-date=July 3, 2026}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://git.jami.net/savoirfairelinux/jami-nameservice/-/tree/master/instructions?ref_type=heads|title=Joining the JAMI Private Network|website=Git.jami.net|access-date=July 3, 2026}}</ref>
